title: Inverse image of modules is left adjoint to direct image (etale sites)
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $V_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $u^{-1}$, $u_*$ the inverse and direct images on sheaves of sets, abelian groups and rings, with unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$, of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $u^{-1}\mathcal G$ be the sheaf of $u^{-1}\mathcal O$-modules with action $u^{-1}(\mu_{\mathcal G}):u^{-1}\mathcal O\times u^{-1}\mathcal G=u^{-1}(\mathcal O\times\mathcal G)\to u^{-1}\mathcal G$; for a sheaf of $u^{-1}\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal F$ on $U_{\Et}$ let $u_*\mathcal F$ be the sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules with action $\mathcal O\times u_*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\eta\times\mathrm{id}}u_*u^{-1}\mathcal O\times u_*\mathcal F=u_*(u^{-1}\mathcal O\times\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{u_*\mu_{\mathcal F}}u_*\mathcal F$. Then a morphism of abelian sheaves $\alpha:u^{-1}\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ is $u^{-1}\mathcal O$-linear if and only if its adjoint $\beta:\mathcal G\to u_*\mathcal F$ under the adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ on abelian sheaves is $\mathcal O$-linear; hence the adjunction bijection restricts to a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{u^{-1}\mathcal O}(u^{-1}\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal G,u_*\mathcal F)$, natural in $\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal F$, and the unit $\mathcal G\to u_*u^{-1}\mathcal G$ and counit $u^{-1}u_*\mathcal F\to\mathcal F$ of the abelian adjunction are linear.

source.place: Lemma 03D3 (lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules), with Lemmas 03D1, 03D2 (lemma-pushforward-module, lemma-pullback-module) for the module structures; the implication 'beta linear => alpha linear' is omitted in the source
